_metadata.description: Operational requirements registry for ecosystem-manager scenario.

requirements.title: Capture per-iteration agent token cost
requirements.description: The controller captures each agent run's token cost from agent-manager's run summary (RunCost) and threads it into credit assignment; an unreported cost is recorded as an explicit unknown, never treated as free.

requirements.title: Per-(skill, dimension) effectiveness ledger
requirements.description: A Postgres-backed effectiveness ledger (skill_dimension_effectiveness) tracks lifetime closed/introduced findings, runs, and token cost per (skill, dimension), with a derived shrinkage-blended efficacy computed on read.

requirements.title: Credit assignment closes the learn loop
requirements.description: After each iteration the controller diffs the open-findings set by stable ID, buckets closed/introduced by dimension (collateral included), and records a credit event to the effectiveness ledger and the decision trace.

requirements.title: Effectiveness-weighted skill selection (bandit)
requirements.description: Within the heaviest open dimension, eligible skills are ranked by expected reduction-per-token (shrinkage toward a uniform prior, n=0 reproduces v0 greedy order) with deterministic epsilon-greedy exploration seeded by (task, iteration).

requirements.title: Layer-2 runtime thrashing defense
requirements.description: The controller halts on a recurring open-findings fingerprint (thrashing_cycle) or a zero net-progress window (no_net_progress), applies a hysteresis cooldown to skills that regressed their own target dimension, and flags/vetoes regressing iterations.

requirements.title: Surface the new control signals (API/CLI/UI)
requirements.description: The decision trace exposes per-iteration token cost, per-dimension findings flow, and regression/veto/halt; a new GET /api/auto-steer/effectiveness endpoint, 'steer effectiveness'/'steer trace' CLI commands, and a UI effectiveness table render the learned efficacy.

requirements.title: DTV-primed trust/cost selection priors
requirements.description: Replace the uniform cold-start prior with development-toolchain-validator-derived trust/cost priors via the injected prior seam in the selector.

requirements.title: DTV Layer-1 eligibility gate
requirements.description: Wire a development-toolchain-validator-backed EligibilityFilter so skills that cannot run in the target toolchain are hard-gated out of selection (Layer-1 thrashing prevention).
